lessonHelp.VIDEO: Video URL (mp4, webm, m3u8). Ideally: hosted on MinIO/Hetzner.
lessonHelp.HTML: Inline HTML rendered in the player. Useful for slides or microcopy.
lessonHelp.PDF: PDF URL. Shown in an iframe at 70dvh.
lessonHelp.TEXT: Long plain text. Line breaks are preserved.
lessonHelp.QUIZ: Create a new quiz or link an existing one by ID. The quiz editor lives at /formador/quizzes/'<id>'.
lessonHelp.SCORM: Upload the SCORM 1.2 / 2004 package ZIP. The system unzips it, parses imsmanifest.xml and serves it in an iframe.

courseContentDescription: Organize your course into sections (modules) and, within each section, lessons.
emptyModulesTitle: Start by creating your first section
emptyModulesHint: Sections group related lessons. For example: Fundamentals, Practice, or Final assessment.
optimizedNote: Optimized: {previous} → {size}. Press “Save changes” to apply it.
alreadyOptimized: The image was already optimized; there was no need to reprocess it.
metadataDescription: The slug and the language can’t be changed after creation. To clear an optional field, leave it empty.
descriptionPlaceholder: What is this course about? Who is it for?
descriptionHelp: Shown in the catalog and under the course cover. Supports bold, lists, headings and links.
categoryTip: Tip: the admin can curate categories with color and icon at /admin/cursos/categorias.
heroHelp: Image and video that students see before enrolling. Once enrolled, the hero is simplified.
optimizeTooltip: Recompress to WebP and resize so it loads faster
imageHelp: PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF (max. 10 MB). It is optimized automatically on upload.
featuredVideoHelp: Paste the Bunny Stream URL (iframe.mediadelivery.net/embed/…), YouTube or an .mp4. It takes priority over the image in the hero.
externalPurchaseHelp: If this course is sold on an external page, paste its URL here. On the course page, the “Buy” button will take students to that page. After payment, that page must enroll the student by calling POST /api/v1/inscribe.
courseIdHelp: Send this identifier in courseIds when calling the enrollment API from your sales page.
readyToPublishHelp: All requirements are met. You can publish whenever you want.
beforePublishHelp: Complete these items so your course is ready:
confirmDeleteLesson: Delete the lesson "{title}"? This is a soft delete: the data is kept and students’ historical progress is not lost, but it will no longer be shown.
confirmDeleteModule: Delete the section "{title}" and its {count} lessons? This is a soft delete: the data is kept but will no longer be shown.
noLessonsYet: No lessons yet. Add the first one below.
certTemplateDescription: If you don’t choose one, the tenant default is used
videoUrlHelp: Accepts YouTube links (with or without a t= timestamp), Bunny Stream (iframe.mediadelivery.net/embed/…) and direct URLs to .mp4 / .webm / .m3u8 files.
resourcesPlaceholder:
00:00 - Introduction
02:15 - Install n8n
Telegram group: https://t.me/...
resourcesHelp: One entry per line. Lines in MM:SS - Text format are shown as clickable chapters that jump to that point of the video; the rest, as resources (links become clickable).
htmlBelowPlaceholder: Notes, steps, links, images… shown below the video.
htmlBelowHelp: Optional rich text that complements the class (headings, lists, links, images). It is sanitized when shown to the student. The video goes on top, in its player.
transcriptEmpty: The file had no usable text.
transcriptWithTimestamps: {name}: {count} blocks with timestamps. The tutor will be able to cite the exact minute.
transcriptPlain: {name}: text without timestamps. The tutor will still use it, but won’t be able to cite the minute.
transcriptPlaceholder:
[0:00] Hi, in this class we’ll look at webhooks.

[0:32] The first step is to create the node…
transcriptHelp: It is not shown to the student: it’s what the AI tutor reads to answer questions about this class. On save, the lesson reindexes itself. If you upload subtitles, they are converted into [mm:ss] text blocks and the tutor will be able to answer “it’s explained at 12:34” linking to that point of the video.
transcriptInvisible: Right now this class is invisible to the tutor.
htmlHelp: The HTML is rendered as-is in the player. If you are going to embed a video, use the “Video” type instead (better watch tracking and resume) and put this content as “complementary content” below the video.
publishAtHelp: Empty = already published. With a future date, the class appears in the list but locked until that moment (the same for all students); students will be able to ask to be notified when it unlocks.
quizEmpty: This lesson has no quiz yet. You can create a new one or paste the UUID of an existing one.
quizIdPlaceholder: …or paste the UUID of an existing quiz
scormDropHelp: Drag or click to select a .zip file with `imsmanifest.xml` at the root.
dripDescription: Release lessons gradually as time passes since each student joins the course. Assign a schedule to a tier (subscription plan) or to an access group. If several apply to a student, the most permissive one wins.
emptySchedules: No drip: all lessons are available from the start.
invitationsDescription: Generate codes so students can enroll without opening public self-enrollment.
tokenUrlLabel: URL token for a direct link:
studentsSubtitle: Who is enrolled, how their progress is going and when they last signed in.
emptyEnrollmentsBody: When someone enrolls in this course, they will show up here. You can generate invitations from the Invitations tab.
progressSubtitle: Watch time per lesson across the course.
noLessonsBody: When the course has modules and lessons, you will see the watch time for each one here.
errorLoadCourses: We couldn’t load your courses. Try refreshing the page.
myCoursesSubtitle: Courses created in your organization: drafts, published and archived.
newCourseDialogDescription: The course stays in draft until you publish it. After creating it we take you to the builder to add sections and lessons.
noCoursesTitle: You don’t have any courses yet
noCoursesBody: Start by creating your first course. You’ll be able to add sections, lessons, quizzes and certificates later.
newCoursePageDescription: The course stays in draft until you publish it. Then you add sections, lessons and content.
